notes: Printer Bot 3.2.0-beta.4 is a prerelease, a test version of 3.2.0 that can have mistakes; it reaches you only with Try prerelease versions on. It lets you put the rules of each printer in the order you want: drag a rule by its handle to move it among the rules of its printer, or focus the handle and press Up or Down. Each printer card now says, under Prints these events, that the rules are checked in order from the top and that the first rule an event matches is the one the printer uses. The rules of printer 1 now follow its Output, Paper size and Tray at once. Everything else is as in 3.2.0-beta.3. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.2.0-beta.4 on GitHub.
